title: Multi-step agent loops compound probabilistic errors exponentially without deterministic validation
text: In an unconstrained agentic chain of n steps with individual reliability p, the overall success probability collapses as P = p^n. An agent with 95% step reliability achieves only ~59% end-to-end success across a 10-step workflow, making open-ended execution fragile unless bounded by strict, deterministic acceptance gates between steps.
qualification: Reliability analysis demonstrating exponential error accumulation in probabilistic systems; establishes architectural necessity for intermediate verification rather than a universal claim that all agentic systems fail.

public_locator.value: If each step has a 95% success rate, a 10-step process succeeds only 59% of the time.
